name: ACCEL Middle College (East Side Union / Evergreen Valley College)
org: East Side Union High School District
what_you_do: Juniors and seniors attend college classes in the morning. The college is Evergreen Valley College. High school classes are in the afternoon.
who_can_apply: East Side Union 10th graders on track to graduate may apply. The school says it fits sophomores (80 to 90 credits) and juniors (140 to 150 credits by January) with a 2.0 GPA or higher, good attendance, and Math II or higher.
pay_detail: No cost listed on the page (public school program)
deadline_text: Last cycle (2026-27): info night on January 27, 2026 and application due February 6, 2026. The 2027-28 dates are not posted as of Nov 2, 2026.
how_to_apply: Go to the yearly info night. Then fill out the online form on the ACCEL How Do I Apply page by the deadline. Questions: ACCEL@esuhsd.org or 408-347-5105.
notes: The dates are from last cycle. You must have passed biology and be taking chemistry and physics. Sophomores also take English 2 or AP Seminar. Juniors take English 3 or AP English.
